name: legacy_identity_trust_threshold
meaning: actor_attribution trusts a frame only if identity_confidence >= this (MEDIUM_THRESH).

name: detection_confidence_by_position_source
meaning: The historical detection_confidence field is quantised by position_source; it is NOT a detector score.
evidence: historical exemplars HE1 (88246efe) and HE2 (40fa0df1): every frame_log record except state REIDENTIFYING (see detection_confidence_reidentifying). R0 erratum E1: R0 said 'all records'.

name: detection_confidence_reidentifying
meaning: Historical detection_confidence on REIDENTIFYING records, which carry position_source CONFIRMED_DETECTION but were written 0.0 (11 of 11 such records in the frozen exemplars).
evidence: HE1 (1 record) and HE2 (10 records); found by the R1-A contract tests

name: box_round_dp
meaning: Rounding for bbox and observed_position_box coordinates.
evidence: HE1 and HE2: every box coordinate has 1 dp

name: confidence_round_dp
meaning: Rounding for historical confidence fields.
evidence: HE2: confidence fields have at most 3 dp

name: camera_shift_round_dp
meaning: Rounding for frame_log camera_shift [dx, dy] px.

name: state_pct_round_dp
meaning: Rounding for summary.selected_state_pct values.

name: timestamp_round_dp
meaning: Rounding for timestamps (event_adapter uses round(frame / fps, 4)).

name: target_track_id
meaning: track_id / identity_id / online_track_id of the one logical target.
evidence: D07 (approved by Nathan); historical seed track was T001 in both frozen JSONs

name: population_track_id_prefix
meaning: Prefix for non-target population tracklet ids (historical T### form).

name: track_source_label
meaning: Historical per-track 'source' field value.
evidence: HE1 and HE2: source == ONLINE in every record

name: untrusted_identity_confidence_ceiling
meaning: When identity_trusted is false, the historical identity_confidence is forced to at most this value, so that surviving actor_attribution treats the frame as untrusted.

name: resume_allowed
meaning: Checkpoint/resume of a Pass-1 run. Must stay False.
evidence: F15: a .mov resume landed +10 frames late (TASK3N STALE_VS_FRESH_REGISTRATION)

name: seed_min_iou
meaning: The run is refused unless a raw detection at the seed frame overlaps the seed box by at least this.

name: frame_thumbnail_size
meaning: Size of the grey thumbnail whose SHA-1 is stored per frame for registration checks.

name: max_frames
meaning: Optional cap on processed frames after the seed; None processes to the end of the video.
evidence: historical default 450 (run_mo); R1 processes the whole clip unless capped

name: seek_mode
meaning: How the reader reaches start_frame. decode_from_zero decodes and discards frames 0..start_frame-1 (no container seek at all); container_seek does ONE CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES seek and then verifies the reported position. Either way, decoding after start_frame is strictly sequential with no further seeks.
evidence: D20; F15 (a container-level resume on .mov landed +10 frames late); the R1 label-sheet tool already decodes from frame 0 for this reason

name: hash_chunk_bytes
meaning: Read size used when hashing the source video with SHA-256.

name: fingerprint_interpolation
meaning: Resize method for the frame-content fingerprint thumbnail (debugging/alignment only).

name: timing_drift_tolerance_frames
meaning: If the container's reported timestamp differs from video_frame_index / fps by more than this many frame periods, the frame is counted as a timing-drift warning (variable frame rate suspected).

name: detector_backend
meaning: Person detector backend.

name: detector_input_size
meaning: Detector network input size. To be chosen on development footage by person-detection quality only (D17).

name: detector_min_score
meaning: Minimum raw person score kept. Low on purpose: partial bodies must still appear as competitors.
evidence: TASK3M: a partially visible target body scored 0.47-0.59; historical Pass-2 conf 0.15 (HISTORICAL_REFERENCE)

name: detector_nms_iou
meaning: Non-maximum-suppression IoU for person boxes.

name: detection_min_height_h
meaning: Detections shorter than this many target heights are ignored as competitors (noise).

name: onnx_intra_op_threads
meaning: ONNX Runtime intra-op thread count (fixed for determinism).

name: onnx_inter_op_threads
meaning: ONNX Runtime inter-op thread count.

name: onnx_sequential_execution
meaning: ONNX Runtime sequential execution mode.

name: appearance_backend
meaning: Appearance backend.

name: composite_weight_lab
meaning: Weight of the LAB part-colour similarity in the composite similarity.
evidence: D04: colour is supporting evidence only

name: composite_weight_embedding
meaning: Weight of the generic embedding similarity (DINOv2, NOT player ReID) in the composite.

name: lab_upper_band
meaning: Vertical band of the box used for the upper-body (shirt) colour descriptor.

name: lab_lower_band
meaning: Vertical band used for the lower-body (shorts) colour descriptor.

name: lab_bins_per_channel
meaning: Histogram bins per LAB channel.

name: crop_min_height_px
meaning: Crops shorter than this give an invalid appearance feature (too few pixels to describe).

name: crop_min_inside_fraction
meaning: Minimum fraction of the box inside the image for a valid appearance feature.

name: appearance_floor
meaning: A box may become the target's observed box only if its similarity to the target bank is >= this.
evidence: D08 test 1. Historical floor 0.30 was a cosine on yolo26n-reid: different scale, not comparable

name: contrastive_margin
meaning: Target similarity minus the best competitor similarity on the same box must be >= this.

name: ambiguity_margin
meaning: The best target candidate must beat the second-best target candidate by >= this.
evidence: D08 test 5. Historical assignment margin 0.08 (a near-miss of 0.081 decided a historical identity swap, F1)

name: contact_memory_s
meaning: How long a competitor that overlapped the target keeps its pre-contact appearance for contrast.

name: target_height_window_s
meaning: Window of recent observed target boxes whose median height defines h.

name: gate_base_h
meaning: Search-gate radius around the predicted target centre when just observed.

name: gate_growth_h_per_s
meaning: Gate growth while the target is unobserved (not while AMBIGUOUS).
evidence: D13. Historical gate_growth 35 px per frame

name: gate_max_h
meaning: Cap on the search-gate radius.

name: gate_grows_while_ambiguous
meaning: Whether the gate grows during AMBIGUOUS. Must stay False.
evidence: F6: unbounded gate growth during AMBIGUOUS led to a relock 234.8 px away

name: motion_veto_max_speed_h_per_s
meaning: Camera-compensated target speed above this vetoes a candidate. A veto only: never proves identity.

name: motion_veto_max_scale_ratio_per_s
meaning: Box-height change faster than this factor per second vetoes a candidate.

name: population_match_iou_min
meaning: Minimum IoU to continue a population tracklet (geometry only; no identity claim).

name: population_max_unmatched_s
meaning: A population tracklet unmatched this long is dropped.

name: population_bank_max_samples
meaning: Appearance samples kept per population tracklet.

name: competitor_radius_h
meaning: Any detection-backed body whose box centre is within this of the target gate is a competitor, from its first frame, regardless of team label or age.

name: merged_area_ratio
units: ratio to recent median target area
meaning: A candidate box larger than this multiple of the target's recent median area is merged-suspect.
evidence: D11; F2 (a historical merged box for two players measured x3.1 the target area)

name: merged_aspect_band
meaning: Aspect ratio outside this band relative to the target's median is merged-suspect.

name: merged_overlap_min
meaning: A box covering at least this fraction of BOTH the target's and a competitor's predicted boxes is merged-suspect.

name: bank_max_samples
meaning: Target appearance bank capacity (diversity-pruned).

name: bank_contact_iou
meaning: No bank update if any competitor box overlaps the target box by more than this.

name: bank_min_crop_quality
meaning: No bank update from a crop below this quality.

name: bank_min_novelty
meaning: A new sample is added only if it differs from its nearest bank sample by at least this.

name: post_reacq_quarantine_s
meaning: No bank update for this long after a reacquisition.

name: max_occluded_s
meaning: OCCLUDED becomes LOST after this long.

name: max_ambiguous_s
meaning: AMBIGUOUS becomes LOST after this long (it must age out).
evidence: D14; F6 (AMBIGUOUS never aged out historically)

name: occluder_cover_min
meaning: If a competitor covers at least this fraction of the target's predicted box, an unobserved target is OCCLUDED rather than LOST.

name: confidence_half_life_s
meaning: identity_confidence_rb halves for every this-many seconds the target goes unconfirmed.

name: reacq_appearance_floor
meaning: Appearance floor during reacquisition (stricter than ordinary association).

name: reacq_contrastive_margin
meaning: Contrastive margin during reacquisition, before any absence growth.

name: reacq_margin_growth_per_s
units: similarity difference per s of absence
meaning: Longer absence raises the reacquisition margin by this much per second.
evidence: D15; R1 approval §F (longer absence, stronger evidence)

name: reacq_margin_cap
meaning: Upper limit of the grown reacquisition margin.

name: reacq_window_s
meaning: Verification window W for a reacquisition candidate.

name: reacq_min_hit_fraction
meaning: The candidate must pass in at least this fraction of the window's frames (K of W).

name: lost_long_s
meaning: After this long LOST, the positional prior is dropped (appearance only).

name: positional_prior_half_life_s
meaning: The positional prior's weight in reacquisition halves every this-many seconds since confirmation.

name: cut_hist_distance_min
meaning: A frame-to-frame grey-histogram distance at least this, together with flow failure, is a hard cut.

name: cut_flow_inlier_fraction_max
meaning: Optical flow with fewer surviving inliers than this counts as flow failure.

name: flow_max_corners
meaning: Maximum background features for global-motion estimation.

name: flow_quality_level
meaning: goodFeaturesToTrack quality level.

name: flow_min_distance_px
meaning: Minimum spacing between flow features.

name: flow_person_mask_pad_h
meaning: Padding around person boxes excluded from background flow.

name: hist_assoc_weight_appearance
meaning: Historical linear association weight (audit only).
evidence: least-squares fit, task3m association_capture.json (116 candidates, max err 0.0007)

name: hist_assoc_weight_motion
meaning: Historical association weight (audit only).

name: hist_assoc_weight_iou_last_box
meaning: Historical association weight (audit only).

name: hist_assoc_weight_colour_hsv
meaning: Historical HSV colour weight (audit only; inverted under contamination, F1e).

name: hist_assoc_weight_size
meaning: Historical association weight (audit only).

name: hist_min_appearance_floor
meaning: Historical appearance floor (audit only).

name: hist_ambiguity_margin
meaning: Historical assignment ambiguity margin (audit only).

name: hist_base_gate_px
meaning: Historical base gate (audit only).

name: hist_gate_growth_px_per_frame
meaning: Historical gate growth (audit only).

name: hist_max_gate_px
meaning: Historical max gate (audit only).

name: hist_fast_path_radius_px
meaning: Historical identity fast-path radius (audit only; the fast path is defect F1 and is not rebuilt).

name: hist_occlusion_to_lost_frames
meaning: Historical OCCLUDED->LOST limit (audit only).

name: hist_max_frames_default
meaning: Historical run_mo max_frames default (audit only).
